name_reality_gap: The index label 'IT Services and IT Consulting' significantly misrepresents EY. The firm's core business is audit/assurance (financial reporting verification for capital markets) and tax advisory — not IT services. Technology consulting is one line among several, and assurance/audit is the dominant one.
extraction_notes: About page was relatively high level. EY service lines (Assurance, Tax, Consulting, Strategy & Transactions) are well-established public knowledge; page confirmed these. No 10-K (private partnership). Function mix based on known service line distribution among Big Four firms.
